quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: When can you legally block an intersection?

options.text: If you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive completely across before the light turns red. If you block the intersection, you can get a ticket.

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in fog?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, or snow. High beams reflect off moisture and make it harder to see.

questions.question: You are in a left turn lane with oncoming traffic ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the left of the center lane.
Signal before you reach the intersection.
Turn your front wheels left to prepare for the turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal before you reach the intersection.
questions.explanation: Start signaling about 100 feet before you turn. Keep your wheels straight until it is safe to turn. This protects you if another car hits you from behind.

questions.question: What does a single broken white centerline mean?

options.text: You must stay in your lane.
You may cross it to change lanes.
You may change lanes only from the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross it to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Broken white lines mean both lanes go in the same direction. You can cross a broken white line to pass or change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: How can you help the car behind you stay at a safe distance?

options.text: Drive 10 mph faster than the car behind you.
Drive 10 mph slower than the car behind you.

questions.explanation: Keep a steady speed and signal before you turn, change lanes, or slow down. This helps the driver behind you maintain a safe distance.

questions.question: What sign is this shape and color?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is a yield sign. Slow down and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line.

questions.question: What must you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Yield to traffic that could cause a crash.
Yield only to vehicles on your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to traffic that could cause a crash.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, let traffic already in the lanes you want to enter or cross go first. You should be ready to stop, but you may go if there is no traffic coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: How should you enter traffic after parking at a curb?

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a big enough gap to match the speed of traffic.
Wait for the first two cars to pass, then drive in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a big enough gap to match the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into traffic, wait for a gap large enough for your car to reach the same speed as other vehicles.

questions.question: What does alcohol affect first?
questions.explanation: Alcohol first affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and skill. These are the abilities you need to drive safely.

questions.question: When a bicyclist is making a left turn, what may they do?

options.text: They may use the left lane.
They may cut through all lanes.
They may wait on the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may use the left lane.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists ride with traffic on the road. You should expect to see a bicyclist use the left lane when turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What can a bad suspension cause?
questions.explanation: Your suspension helps you control your vehicle and provides a comfortable ride. If your vehicle bounces a lot after hitting a bump or is hard to control, you may need new suspension parts.

questions.question: What message appears on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: How can you identify an aggressive driver?

options.text: Their erratic and improper lane changes.
The number of passengers in their car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their erratic and improper lane changes.
questions.explanation: Watch for other drivers' actions while driving. If you see a driver making erratic or improper lane changes, stay away from them. The safest action is to let an aggressive driver pass.

questions.question: When should you allow extra following distance?

options.text: When following a driver who cannot see the rear of their vehicle.
When following a small passenger car.

questions.correctAnswerText: When following a driver who cannot see the rear of their vehicle.
questions.explanation: Drivers of trucks, buses, vans, or vehicles with trailers may not see you directly behind them. Stay further back from these vehicles. Large vehicles also block your view of the road ahead, so increase your following distance to see around them.

questions.question: What is the only effective way to remove alcohol from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Eating, drinking coffee, or taking a shower will not speed this up.

questions.question: When backing up, what should you do?

options.text: Press hard on the gas pedal.
Rely only on your rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: When backing up, place your right arm on the back of the passenger seat and look directly out the rear window. Do not depend on mirrors alone, as they do not show the area directly behind your vehicle. Back up slowly.

questions.question: If someone is tailgating you on a two-lane road, what should you do?

options.text: Reduce your speed slowly to encourage the tailgater to drive around you.
Speed up to increase the distance between you and the other car.
Apply your brakes to slow down, then resume your original speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed slowly to encourage the tailgater to drive around you.
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, try to move to a different lane. If you cannot change lanes, slowly reduce your speed. This will encourage the tailgater to pass you.

questions.question: How can you check your blind spot when changing lanes?

options.text: Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Mirrors cannot show all areas around your vehicle. Before changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder to check the blind spots that mirrors cannot show.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: Drivers must obey instructions from:

options.text: Other drivers whose vehicles are broken down on the road.

questions.explanation: Drivers must obey signs and instructions from flaggers. They are there to keep drivers and workers safe.

questions.question: When passing, you should move back into the right lane when:

options.text: You are one vehicle length ahead of the other vehicle.
You can see both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
You are 50 feet ahead of the other vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: You need enough space to return to the right lane safely. When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror, it is safe to move back.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is allowed with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangerous conditions ahead. These might include a change in traffic direction, a steep hill, or another hazard.

questions.question: Vehicles behind a school bus with red lights flashing must stay stopped until:

options.text: All students are off the bus.
The stop arm is pulled in.
The stop arm is pulled in and the bus starts moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: The stop arm is pulled in and the bus starts moving.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has red lights flashing and the stop arm out, you must stay stopped. You can only go when the lights are off, the stop arm is pulled in, and the bus moves again.

questions.question: Can you drive off the road to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Yes, if the vehicle ahead is turning left.
Yes, if there are two or more lanes in your direction.

questions.explanation: You must never drive off the road or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill ahead. Check your brakes before going down.
